messages.subject: Re: [tRophicPosition-support] R version for tRophicPosition
messages.body_plain:
Dear Guillaume and Mélanie

Apologies for the late response, I just come back from a long trip abroad.

I have seen that tRophicPosition is not compatible with the latest version of R, and I will update the package asap.

I just installed it through GitHub (remember that you need to install JAGS for your platform as well):

install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("clquezada/tRophicPosition", build_vignettes = TRUE)
Please let me know if this works for you.

Cheers

Claudio

messages.subject: Individual Estimates Available?
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I’ve been using tRophicposition for about a year now and have had a great time with the package, first working through the Vingettes and then applying it to my own data. One question I have is whether individual estimates (estimates for individuals in the sample) can be obtained as output, or if only the posterior summaries for the whole sample is available?

Thank you for your help,

Bethany

Bethany Bethke

Fisheries Research Scientist | Fish and Wildlife

Minnesota Department of Natural Resources

Duluth MN,  55805

messages.subject: Re: [tRophicPosition-support] Individual Estimates Available?
messages.body_plain:
Hi Bethany

I'm glad you found the package useful. Unfortunately, at this time it is not possible to have individual estimates of trophic position, but we are working on that model and hopefully it will be available soon.

Best wishes,

Claudio
